dropWindow.note: Pokémon Center queues usually open on weekdays between 10am and 4pm US Eastern, which is 3pm to 9pm UK this week, most often around 5pm. Recent US queues: 11:44am ET (Delta Reign, 30 Sep), 12:36pm ET (Mini Tins, 15 Oct) and a reported but unconfirmed queue at about 11:06am ET on Wed 21 Oct, i.e. 4:44pm, 5:36pm and 4:06pm UK. UK clocks go back on Sun 25 Oct and US clocks on Sun 1 Nov, so for 26 to 30 Oct the window is 2pm to 8pm UK, peak about 4pm.

news.summary: A TCG restock account announced a live Pokémon Center queue at about 11:06am ET (4:06pm UK). The products were not named and tracker sites have not logged it yet, so treat it as unconfirmed.
news.title: US Pokémon Center queue reported on Wed 21 Oct

news.summary: PokéBeach says the seventh Mega Evolution set will be Flowing Fists, a small set mirroring Japan's Aura Seeker and led by Mega Lucario Z ex, with prereleases from 23 Jan. The Pokémon Company has not confirmed it yet.
news.title: Next English set reported as Flowing Fists, 5 February

news.summary: A tracker guide notes no Pokémon Center preorders for the Ultra-Premium Collections as of 16 Oct and says large items have been sold through emailed invitations since 5 Oct. It also lists more 30th Celebration products for 4 Dec.
news.title: Big 30th Celebration items going via invites, not preorders

news.summary: Booster Bundles and Mini Tins remain sold out on the UK store with no restock date, while Smyths lists the premium Ultra-Premium, Ditto and figure collections for 6 November.
news.title: 30th Celebration wave 2 still sold out at Pokémon Center UK

news.summary: The support page still lists the UK Delta Reign ETB, Booster Bundle and Display Box for early November and the UK 30th Celebration ETB and Knock Out Collection for mid to late November.
news.title: Preorder ship-dates page unchanged since 5 Oct

news.summary: A competitive starter kit with a Meowth ex, a booster pack, a guidebook and 39 tournament-ready Trainer cards releases on 23 October.
news.title: Deck Crafter's Collection out this Friday

news.summary: Delta Reign preorders opened on 30 September, 37 days before the 6 November launch, and sold out the same day; the exclusive ETB quickly traded well above retail.
news.title: Delta Reign preorders sold out on day one

news.summary: UK buyers were told on release day that their 30th Celebration Pokémon Center ETB orders would ship in mid to late November, with a 10% code offered for a future order.
news.title: 30th Celebration Pokémon Center ETB delayed in the UK
